title: Close a reconciliation review
caption: OAD-022 / OBE-099. Admin: bookings/[bookingId]/review-dialog.tsx and actions.ts closeBookingReview. API: ota/backend/src/console/review-closure.service.ts. Runbook supplier-timeout-and-reconciliation.md §4.3.

steps.label: Order found + record locator, or Not booked + note (≤ 2,000 characters)
booking pending with reconcile_outcome = manual_review? else 409 not_in_review
order_found: read the order in the booking's queuing office
steps.note: Accepted only with the remark VELEXIS <reference> (BACKOFFICE) of this booking, else remark_mismatch; 409 ORDER_ALREADY_IMPORTED; 403 OFFICE_NOT_ALLOWED

steps.label: order_found: booking confirmed, reconcile_outcome = found, checkout completed
not_booked: booking failed (SUPPLIER_TIMEOUT), reconcile_outcome = not_found, checkout reopened or expired
both: booking.reconcile_closed (staff-only), staff.note, staff_actions booking.reconcile_close (note as reason)
found + Stripe: payment.capture_retry → issuance per ticketing policy; not booked + Stripe: payment.void + booking.not_confirmed e-mail
steps.note: Airline card, not booked: payment failed, no e-mail; the agent asks the airline about a charge

steps.label: revalidate: new status, no Close the review, gone from the Reconciliation review view
